automation_outbox_credential_reference_m.name: automation_outbox_credential_reference_matches_event
automation_outbox_credential_reference_m.value:
(("automation_outbox"."event_type" in ('credential.created', 'credential.verification_changed', 'credential.expiry_due', 'credential.lifecycle_changed')) and "automation_outbox"."credential_id" is not null)
        or (("automation_outbox"."event_type" in ('employee.lifecycle_changed', 'employee.invitation_changed', 'schedule.lifecycle_changed', 'schedule_request.lifecycle_changed')) and "automation_outbox"."credential_id" is null)

credentials_active_file_url_unique.name: credentials_active_file_url_unique
credentials_active_file_url_unique.where: "credentials"."deleted_at" is null and "credentials"."file_url" is not null

email_log_digest_week_unique.name: email_log_digest_week_unique
email_log_digest_week_unique.where: kind = 'weekly_digest' and week_key is not null

email_otp_challenges_code_material_valid.name: email_otp_challenges_code_material_valid
email_otp_challenges_code_material_valid.value:
(("email_otp_challenges"."status" in ('dispatching', 'pending', 'verifying', 'approved')) and "email_otp_challenges"."code_salt" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' and "email_otp_challenges"."code_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
        or ("email_otp_challenges"."status" not in ('dispatching', 'pending', 'verifying', 'approved') and "email_otp_challenges"."code_salt" is null and "email_otp_challenges"."code_hash" is null)

email_otp_challenges_terminal_state_vali.name: email_otp_challenges_terminal_state_valid
email_otp_challenges_terminal_state_vali.value:
("email_otp_challenges"."status" = 'approved' and "email_otp_challenges"."verified_at" is not null and "email_otp_challenges"."consumed_at" is null)
        or ("email_otp_challenges"."status" = 'consumed' and "email_otp_challenges"."verified_at" is not null and "email_otp_challenges"."consumed_at" is not null)
        or ("email_otp_challenges"."status" not in ('approved', 'consumed') and "email_otp_challenges"."verified_at" is null and "email_otp_challenges"."consumed_at" is null)

email_otp_challenges_lease_state_valid.name: email_otp_challenges_lease_state_valid
email_otp_challenges_lease_state_valid.value:
("email_otp_challenges"."status" = 'dispatching' and "email_otp_challenges"."dispatch_started_at" is not null and "email_otp_challenges"."verification_started_at" is null)
        or ("email_otp_challenges"."status" = 'verifying' and "email_otp_challenges"."dispatch_started_at" is null and "email_otp_challenges"."verification_started_at" is not null)
        or ("email_otp_challenges"."status" not in ('dispatching', 'verifying') and "email_otp_challenges"."dispatch_started_at" is null and "email_otp_challenges"."verification_started_at" is null)

employee_invitations_terminal_state.name: employee_invitations_terminal_state
employee_invitations_terminal_state.value:
not ("employee_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "employee_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null)
        and (("employee_invitations"."accepted_at" is null and "employee_invitations"."accepted_user_id" is null)
          or ("employee_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "employee_invitations"."accepted_user_id" is not null))

users_phone_verification_requires_phone.name: users_phone_verification_requires_phone
users_phone_verification_requires_phone.value: "users"."phone_verified_at" is null or "users"."phone" is not null

phone_otp_challenges_provider_state_vali.name: phone_otp_challenges_provider_state_valid
phone_otp_challenges_provider_state_vali.value:
("phone_otp_challenges"."status" in ('pending', 'verifying', 'approved') and "phone_otp_challenges"."provider_verification_sid" is not null)
        or ("phone_otp_challenges"."status" not in ('pending', 'verifying', 'approved') and "phone_otp_challenges"."provider_verification_sid" is null)

phone_otp_challenges_terminal_state_vali.name: phone_otp_challenges_terminal_state_valid
phone_otp_challenges_terminal_state_vali.value:
("phone_otp_challenges"."status" = 'approved' and "phone_otp_challenges"."verified_at" is not null and "phone_otp_challenges"."approval_proof_hash" is not null and "phone_otp_challenges"."consumed_at" is null)
        or ("phone_otp_challenges"."status" = 'consumed' and "phone_otp_challenges"."verified_at" is not null and "phone_otp_challenges"."approval_proof_hash" is null and "phone_otp_challenges"."consumed_at" is not null)
        or ("phone_otp_challenges"."status" not in ('approved', 'consumed') and "phone_otp_challenges"."verified_at" is null and "phone_otp_challenges"."approval_proof_hash" is null and "phone_otp_challenges"."consumed_at" is null)

phone_otp_challenges_lease_state_valid.name: phone_otp_challenges_lease_state_valid
phone_otp_challenges_lease_state_valid.value:
("phone_otp_challenges"."status" = 'dispatching' and "phone_otp_challenges"."dispatch_started_at" is not null and "phone_otp_challenges"."verification_started_at" is null)
        or ("phone_otp_challenges"."status" = 'verifying' and "phone_otp_challenges"."dispatch_started_at" is null and "phone_otp_challenges"."verification_started_at" is not null)
        or ("phone_otp_challenges"."status" not in ('dispatching', 'verifying') and "phone_otp_challenges"."dispatch_started_at" is null and "phone_otp_challenges"."verification_started_at" is null)

upload_grants_processing_lifecycle_check.name: upload_grants_processing_lifecycle_check
upload_grants_processing_lifecycle_check.value:
(
        ("upload_grants"."status" = 'pending'
          AND "upload_grants"."processing_token" IS NULL
          AND "upload_grants"."processing_started_at" IS NULL
          AND "upload_grants"."processed_at" IS NULL
          AND "upload_grants"."processed_sha256" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("upload_grants"."status" = 'processing'
          AND "upload_grants"."processing_token" IS NOT NULL
          AND "upload_grants"."processing_started_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "upload_grants"."processed_at" IS NULL
          AND "upload_grants"."processed_sha256" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("upload_grants"."status" = 'processed'
          AND "upload_grants"."processing_token" IS NULL
          AND "upload_grants"."processing_started_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "upload_grants"."processed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "upload_grants"."processed_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
      )

schedule_requests_kind_shape.name: schedule_requests_kind_shape
schedule_requests_kind_shape.value: ("schedule_requests"."kind" = 'leave' or "schedule_requests"."start_date" = "schedule_requests"."end_date") and (("schedule_requests"."kind" = 'preferred_shift' and "schedule_requests"."shift_code" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_-]{0,7}$') or ("schedule_requests"."kind" <> 'preferred_shift' and "schedule_requests"."shift_code" is null))

schedule_requests_note_length.name: schedule_requests_note_length
schedule_requests_note_length.value: "schedule_requests"."note" is null or char_length("schedule_requests"."note") between 1 and 500

schedule_requests_schedule_snapshot_comp.name: schedule_requests_schedule_snapshot_complete
schedule_requests_schedule_snapshot_comp.value: ("schedule_requests"."evaluated_schedule_id" is null and "schedule_requests"."evaluated_schedule_version" is null) or ("schedule_requests"."evaluated_schedule_id" is not null and "schedule_requests"."evaluated_schedule_version" >= 1)

schedule_requests_decision_shape.name: schedule_requests_decision_shape
schedule_requests_decision_shape.value: ("schedule_requests"."status" in ('approved', 'rejected') and "schedule_requests"."decided_by" is not null and "schedule_requests"."decided_at" is not null) or ("schedule_requests"."status" in ('pending', 'withdrawn') and "schedule_requests"."decided_by" is null and "schedule_requests"."decided_at" is null)
